api.py reads no repository config and call(operation, payload) receives only the tool arguments from server._call, so with the server unchanged load_creds must read jira.site itself, per call, from afk-config's project_root()

Every load_creds caller calls it with no arguments and relies on the (base, email, token) tuple and on SystemExit when unresolved: publish_prd.py:267, publish_meeting.py:128, publish_bug.py:299, client() api.py:464-466, main --check-creds api.py:649, call() api.py:639-642; keeping name, no-arg call, tuple and SystemExit leaves all of them unchanged

Two by-path callers depend on resolve_creds_env's no-arg, field-keyed dict: afk-config.py:955 (.get('JIRA_BASE_URL'), only ImportError caught, so a TypeError or AttributeError crashes init) and developer_values.py:116 (.get('JIRA_EMAIL'), any exception swallowed, so the trackerAssignee suggestion silently disappears)
developer_values status acts on the --repo root, but jira_email() passes no root, so a jira.site read from project_root() would come from the cwd/CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR repository rather than --repo

Adding jira.site requires `site` in CHILD_KEYS['jira'] (afk-config.py:109) and in CONFIG.md's jira row in the same commit; otherwise validate reports 'jira.site: unknown key' and exits 2

Removing credentials-env from CHILD_KEYS makes every config carrying it fail validation with exit 2 rather than warn, and fails test_shipped_samples_validate on scripts/tests/samples/monorepo-config.yaml:21; validate has no deprecation-warning channel (its only warnings are path_warnings), so L3-6's 'validate warns' needs the key kept in CHILD_KEYS plus a new warning

adapter.json:25 lists jira.credentials-env in configKeys; the only reader, adapter_registry_check.py:107-110, accepts any jira.* key because `jira` appears in CONFIG.md, so a stale or a new entry trips no gate

Adding JIRA_SITE_<KEY>_* keys to the same tracker env block breaks neither side: the readers return the whole env dict (api.py:74-104), the writer starts from dict(existing_env) (setup_secrets.py:193) and register replaces the entry with that merged env (tracker_registration.py:71-78); no code writes ~/.codex/config.toml's tracker env (codex_marketplace_ref.py removes only marketplaces.afk-toolkit.ref)

The nine tracker_* MCP tools carry no credential or site argument; a sign-in failure reaches the caller as {error, operation, reason} through call()'s SystemExit catch plus config_root from _named, so the tool surface is unchanged while the new error stays a SystemExit

If load_creds raises anything but SystemExit (for example the config reader's ConfigError), it escapes call() and server._call, which wraps only _api(); and a ConfigError from an afk-config module api.py executes itself is a different class from server._CONFIG.ConfigError
client() calls load_creds on every REST request, so a config read inside load_creds adds a project_root() git spawn and a config parse per request (tracker_create makes up to five)
